 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blue revolution** is associated with **fish**.
 
• **Yellow revolution** pertains to **oilseeds**.
 
• **Round revolution** is linked to **potato**.
 
• **Golden revolution** refers to **overall horticulture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Blue Revolution** aims to increase the production of fish and other aquatic life forms to ensure food security and improve the livelihoods of those involved in fisheries.
 
• The **Yellow Revolution** focuses on increasing the production of oilseeds to achieve self-sufficiency in edible oils.
 
• The **Round Revolution** is targeted at enhancing the production of potatoes, a staple food and an important cash crop.
 
• The **Golden Revolution** encompasses the overall development of horticulture, including fruits, vegetables, flowers, spices, and aromatic plants.
